gb.title: DTJ DESIGN celebrates historic award win for Baha Bay at Baha Mar
gb.description: DTJ DESIGN, a multi-disciplinary architecture, planning, and landscape architecture practice, has once again been recognised at the 2026 World Travel Awards, where its project Baha Bay at Baha Mar has been named the Caribbean's Leading Water Park for the fifth consecutive year. The historic win continues the destination's perfect record, which it has held since the category's introduction. The award further cements Baha Bay's reputation as one of the world's leading aquatic attractions, bringing together innovative water experiences, top-tier food and beverages, immersive entertainment, and authentic Bahamian design within the wider Baha Mar resort. DTJ DESIGN serves as the park's prime consultant, providing concept visioning, master planning, architecture, and landscape architecture. Since its launch, Baha Bay has set a new standard for Caribbean water parks, combining thrilling attractions with premium hospitality. Its continued success demonstrates the long-term dedication of its ownership, operations teams, and design partners to the ongoing evolution of the visitor experience. John Torti, partner at DTJ DESIGN, says: "It is truly incredible. It really is. "This is our fifth year winning, and it truly is a testament to all the hard work and dedication, not only from the design staff at DTJ DESIGN, but the resort ownership, operations team, and the incredibly talented group of people who have come together to make Baha Bay what it is today. "To win five years in a row is an extraordinary achievement." Quality and authenticity The accolade reflects a vision that looks far beyond rides and attractions, adds Torti. "From the beginning, Baha Bay was conceived as a fully integrated destination. The plan was always to create a state-of-the-art experience that encompasses not only world-class rides, but also food and beverage programs, entertainment, events, conferences, and year-round activation. "Baha Mar has done an incredible job bringing that vision to life. They have truly embraced every aspect of the guest experience, and our continued support as designers has been focused on helping that vision evolve and grow." The award comes as the destination continues to strengthen its international reputation. Baha Bay has repeatedly received recognition from both travellers and sector professionals for its unique approach, which melds high-quality attractions with authentic cultural storytelling and a strong connection to the Bahamian location. While many water parks concentrate on rides, Baha Bay was developed to offer a multidimensional resort experience that combines aquatic adventures, luxury facilities, entertainment programming, and destination dining into a coherent visitor journey. "This achievement demonstrates what is possible when owners, operators, and designers remain aligned around a shared vision," says Torti. "The team has never stopped investing inthe experience, and that commitment is reflected in the guests who visit every year and in theindustry recognition the destination continues to receive." Earlier this year, Summit Canyon opened at Water World in Colorado, US. The themed expansion was delivered through close partnership between DTJ DESIGN, Proslide Technology, Aquatic Development Group (ADG), Kiowa Engineering, and park owner Hyland Hills Parks and Recreation District.

fr.title: Marc Marquez avant le GP de Malaisie de MotoGP : "Nous devons rester concentrés"
fr.description: Marc Marquez aborde le GP de Malaisie de MotoGP 2026 dans la peau du leader du championnat du monde alors que Jorge Martin n'est pas certain de pouvoir participer à l'épreuve. Il appelle toutefois son équipe à se méfier d'un quelconque triomphalisme. Marc Marquez a quitté l'Australie dimanche dernier en leader du championnat du monde des pilotes. Le champion du monde en titre compte 10 points d'avance sur Jorge Martin après avoir remporté la course Sprint samedi et vu son rival pour le titre chuter lourdement et se blesser. Une victoire qui lui a donné un regain d'énergie comme il l'a déclaré dans un communiqué envoyé par Ducati à la presse ce mercredi 28 octobre : "La course de samedi en Australie m’a donné un vrai coup de boost". Il appelle toutefois à se méfier et rester focus sur l'objectif de cette fin de championnat. À savoir remporter le titre mondial : "Nous devons rester concentrés. L’objectif est de continuer à jouer les premiers rôles et de gérer au mieux chaque séance ainsi que nos efforts tout au long du week-end". Marc Marquez se méfie de la météo à Sepang Marc Marquez se méfie également de la météo en Malaisie car la pluie peut s'abattre subitement et en grande quantité en quelques minutes : "Sepang est un circuit complètement différent de Phillip Island, et les conditions météo rendent toujours les choses plus compliquées ici".

fr.title: Coupe de France : tirage clément pour l’OCPAM, Sedan affrontera le club de Sadio Mané
fr.description: Lecture zen Le tirage au sort du 7e tour de la Coupe de France, qui a été effectué ce mercredi 28 octobre depuis le prestigieux stade Roland-Garros à Paris, n’a pas réservé de gros choc aux deux derniers représentants ardennais. Premier fixé, l’Olympique Charleville/Prix (N2) a hérité d’un adversaire dans ses cordes : il recevra le 14 ou le 15 novembre au stade du Petit-Bois les Nordistes de Marcq-en-Barœul, pensionnaires de Régional 1, soit un niveau en dessous. De son côté, le CS Sedan Ardennes de Kalidou Koulibaly recevra aussi, mais un adversaire hiérarchiquement supérieur de deux divisions : le FC Bourges (National 1), club qui a la particularité d’être détenu à 75 % par une autre star sénégalaise, Sadio Mané. La perspective d’un remake face au Stade de Reims Le tirage de ce mercredi a aussi permis de déterminer les affiches du 8e tour. En cas de qualification, l’OCPAM pourrait ainsi retrouver sur sa route le 28 novembre… le Stade de Reims (Ligue 2), contre qui il s’était incliné de justesse la saison dernière (0-1). Un match qui laisse toujours de « très gros regrets » dans l’esprit du coach ardennais Guillaume Richard. Si le CSSA écarte Bourges, il affronterait de son côté le vainqueur du match Crosne (R2) – Cosne (R1). Mis en ligne le 28/10/2026 à 11:52 Coupe de France : tirage clément pour l’OCPAM, Sedan affrontera le club de Sadio Mané Par Aurelien Avigliano Au 7e tour de la Coupe de France, Charleville/Prix accueillera Marcq-en-Barœul (R1), tandis que le CSSA recevra Bourges (N1).

es.title: María Gemio (75 años): "Hay un paralelismo entre el montañismo y la ayuda social; en ambos haces un esfuerzo que te hace cada día mejor"
es.description: Hay vidas que no caben en un currículum tradicional, y la de María Gemio (Badajoz, 1950) es una de ellas. Aventurera de profesión y luchadora social de vocación, rompió todos los estereotipos de la época: decidió no tener hijos para abrazar el mundo entero, desafió los prejuicios coronando el Mont Blanc o el Ártico siendo la única mujer, y lleva más de un cuarto de siglo siendo el refugio de los inmigrantes en Badajoz. Estudió y trabajó como secretaria y hasta vendió pisos en una época en la que apenas se construía en la ciudad. Sin embargo, su verdadera vocación siempre ha estado fuera de una simple oficina. De niña soñaba con ser misionera en Venezuela, aunque aquel plan se truncó por algunos problemas gubernamentales, su actitud y el amor le tenían reservada otra misión: entregar su vida, su tiempo y su energía a las montañas y a los más vulnerables.

pt.title: W Shopping festeja 23 anos
pt.description: O Centro comercial assinala esta quarta-feira, 28 de outubro, mais de duas décadas de proximidade, confiança e caminho partilhado com a comunidade de Santarém. Ao longo destes 23 anos, o W Shopping tem acompanhado a evolução da cidade e feito parte da vidade várias gerações. Mais do que um espaço de compras, tem sido um ponto de encontro, de convívioe de experiências, mantendo uma relação próxima com a cidade, quem o visita, trabalha e participanas suas iniciativas. Nesta data especial, o W Shopping deixa um agradecimento sentido a todos os Scalabitanos pelaconfiança, pelo carinho e pela presença constante. Cada visita, cada momento partilhado e cadamemória criada contribuíram para escrever esta história conjunta e para dar significado ao caminhofeito em conjunto. “Celebrar 23 anos é, acima de tudo, celebrar as pessoas que fazem parte do W Shopping. Esteaniversário pertence também aos Scalabitanos, que nos têm acompanhado desde o primeiro dia e comquem queremos continuar a construir o futuro”, sublinha a Administração do W Shopping. Com os olhos postos nos próximos anos, o W Shopping reafirma o compromisso de continuar próximoda comunidade, de valorizar Santarém e de proporcionar experiências relevantes a todos os que oescolhem. O futuro continuará a ser construído com a mesma proximidade, dedicação e vontade decrescer lado a lado com a cidade. Hoje pelas 17h, no Piso 2, estão todos convidados a cantar os Parabéns e brindar a mais um ano juntos! Parabéns, W Shopping! O conteúdo W Shopping festeja 23 anos aparece primeiro em Jornal O Almeirinense.

in.title: QwikBuild Raises $2.3M to Bring AI Agents Into Enterprise Systems
in.description: Bengaluru-based QwikBuild is targeting this opportunity with a platform that uses AI agents to develop customized enterprise software and automate workflows. The startup announced on October 28 that it has raised $2.3 million in pre-seed funding, backed by Globalway Inc., Blume Ventures, Marsshot and DeVC. Angel investors in the round include Lalit Keshre, Founder, Groww, and Ankit Nagori, Founder, Cure.fit. Alongside the funding, QwikBuild announced a joint venture with Japan's publicly listed Globalway Inc. to enter the Japanese enterprise market. The development brings together two closely linked ambitions: making custom software development faster through AI and expanding that approach into a market where enterprises face challenges modernizing established IT systems. The company has not disclosed its valuation, the allocation of funding among investors or the ownership structure of the joint venture. Building Software Around Existing Systems QwikBuild's approach differs from conventional enterprise software deployment, where businesses often adapt their workflows to fit the capabilities of an existing application. Instead, the startup aims to build software around specific operational requirements using autonomous AI agents. According to the company, its platform can develop custom enterprise applications in days rather than months, although it has not disclosed independent performance comparisons or detailed project timelines to substantiate that claim. QwikBuild offers three approaches to enterprise modernization. Businesses can replace an existing legacy application, develop a customized software layer on top of platforms such as SAP and Salesforce, or build an application from scratch. Once the software is deployed, enterprises can integrate AI agents to manage recurring operational tasks. The proposition is particularly relevant for companies that have already invested heavily in enterprise resource planning (ERP) and customer relationship management (CRM) systems but still encounter gaps between those platforms and their everyday operations. Rather than replacing an entire technology stack, a business could build a specific application to address those gaps. However, faster application development is only part of the equation. Enterprise software must also work reliably with existing systems, maintain data integrity and remain secure and maintainable after deployment. Those requirements will be critical as AI-generated applications move from smaller projects into business-critical operations. QwikBuild's Expansion Into Japan QwikBuild's expansion into Japan will be supported by its joint venture with Globalway, which brings local enterprise relationships and knowledge of Japanese business operations. The partnership is intended to combine QwikBuild's AI-driven software development capabilities with Globalway's experience in the Japanese market. For QwikBuild, the arrangement provides a way to enter an international enterprise market without relying entirely on building its own local customer network from the ground up. Pradeep Ayyagari, Founder and CEO, QwikBuild, said: "We have been working together with Globalway to develop 'QwikBuild' into a service that meets the demands of the enterprise market, including Japan." He said Globalway's understanding of Japanese enterprises and system development requirements had contributed to the platform's development. The strategic rationale is straightforward. Japanese companies looking to modernize established business applications may need technology that can accommodate existing operational processes without requiring a complete systems overhaul. Masato Kakamu, Chairman and CEO, Globalway Co., Ltd., highlighted the challenge: "Japanese companies have long faced the challenge of system development requiring long periods of time and a large workforce, making it difficult to keep up with changes in business operations." The joint venture is intended to address those challenges by bringing AI-assisted application development closer to business teams. However, the companies have not disclosed customer acquisition targets, revenue expectations or a timeline for scaling their Japanese operations. Enterprise Deployments Show the Use Cases QwikBuild says its platform is already being used by enterprises across the United States, Singapore and India. The company has shared examples of deployments involving supply chain management, procurement and human resources. In one case, an electronics component exporter uses software and AI agents developed by QwikBuild on top of its existing SAP infrastructure to manage shipment and supply chain operations. Another industrial procurement company has implemented AI agents to automate payment processing workflows connected to SAP. The company also reports that a health technology organization with approximately 3,000 employees replaced its applicant tracking and HR systems with applications built using QwikBuild, including migrating existing data. These examples illustrate the range of operational processes the platform is targeting. They also suggest that QwikBuild is positioning itself around specific enterprise workflows rather than attempting to replace established ERP platforms across every function. However, the company has not disclosed measurable results from these deployments, such as implementation costs, time savings, automation accuracy or reductions in manual effort. Such metrics will become increasingly important for enterprises evaluating whether AI-generated custom applications deliver meaningful advantages over traditional development. Can AI Change Enterprise Software Development? The emergence of AI-powered development platforms is raising questions about how organizations will build and maintain business applications. Traditionally, even relatively narrow customization requirements can involve lengthy development cycles, integration work and ongoing maintenance. AI-based development tools could reduce some of that effort by automating parts of application creation. But building software faster does not necessarily mean that the resulting applications are ready for long-term enterprise use. Organizations still need to consider access controls, security, data governance, integration testing and responsibility for maintaining software as business requirements change. The challenge becomes more complex when AI agents are allowed to execute operational workflows. An agent handling payment processing or shipment operations needs to perform reliably, particularly when errors could affect financial records or business continuity. For QwikBuild, the ability to demonstrate dependable performance in these environments will be as important as the speed of application development. What Comes Next for QwikBuild? The $2.3 million funding round and Japan joint venture give QwikBuild additional backing as it pursues enterprise customers beyond its existing markets. Its strategy reflects a broader opportunity emerging around AI-assisted software development: helping businesses create applications tailored to their operations without committing to lengthy conventional development projects. The company's combination of application development, integration with existing enterprise platforms and operational AI agents is designed to address that need. However, enterprise adoption will depend on more than how quickly applications can be generated. Businesses will need evidence that these systems are secure, reliable, maintainable and capable of delivering measurable operational improvements. The Japan partnership could provide an important test of that proposition in a market with established enterprise systems and demanding operational requirements.

ph.title: UNESCO-Listed Nandagang Wetland Launches Global Photo Contest on Migratory Birds and Wetland Conservation
ph.description: The 2026 contest, a key component of Global Wetland Week invites photographers worldwide to tell stories of wetlands and migratory birds along the East Asian–Australasian Flyway. Nandagang Wetland lies within the UNESCO-listed Yellow Sea–Bohai Gulf migratory bird sanctuary, a vital link in a flyway spanning about 22 countries. CANGZHOU, China, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cangzhou International Communication Center has launched Global Wetland Week, an international campaign that uses wetlands as common ground for dialogue and cultural exchange. A key component of the campaign is the 2026 Nandagang International Wetland Photo Contest, which invites photographers and video creators around the world to share wetland stories through images and bring wider public attention to wetland conservation. 2026 Nandagang Wetland Photo Contest | A Message from Our Judges Located in Cangzhou, Hebei Province, Nandagang Wetland is part of the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Migratory Bird Sanctuaries along the Coast of Yellow Sea-Bohai Gulf of China. In recent years, more than 300 hectares of wetland have been restored. Migratory bird numbers rose from about 20,000 in 2019 to more than 150,000 in 2025, while recorded bird species increased from 268 in 2021 to 274, according to the Cangzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau. Under the theme "Together for Wetlands," the contest welcomes photographs and videos about wetland landscapes, migratory birds, local communities and conservation. It is open to photographers, videographers, nature observers and young creators worldwide. Reflecting on the inaugural edition, Ma Chaode, Assistant Resident Representative at UNDP in China, said: "Wetlands, one of the three major ecosystems, are known as the 'Kidneys of the Earth.' They have functions like provision, support, regulation and culture, and are the foundation for the sustainable development of human society. The numerous wetland ecological images collected in the event vividly show the real - life beautiful scenery of the harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. It's not only a vivid microcosm of "Beautiful China", but also a typical case for promoting global ecological civilization." "For me, photography is a way to connect people with nature and inspire its conservation," said Mario Suárez Porras, president of AFONAS and a judge for this year's contest. "I'm excited to see creative works for this year's theme." The contest is organized by Cangzhou International Communication Center, hosted by Xinhuanet North America, with media support from Xinhuanet Hebei Channel. Email submissions are available as a backup at cangzhouNDGphotoweek@gmail.com. Awards and recognition: A US$1,500 Grand Prize, additional cash prizes, special awards and honorable mentions. Entries will be reviewed by a ten-member international jury. For complete eligibility requirements, submission instructions, technical specifications and copyright terms, visit globalsouthernnews.com/ndg2026

ph.title: Meta and Snap face major US legal test of youth social media addiction claims
ph.description: Meta and Snap face major US legal test of youth social media addiction claims melissa_fernan… Wed, 28 Oct 2026 - 18:34 TWO teenage plaintiffs who say social media caused them to develop serious mental health problems will take Meta Platforms and Snap to trial in Los Angeles on Wednesday in the latest test of claims raised in thousands of US lawsuits over social media's impact on young people. The case is only the second to go to trial involving individual plaintiffs who allege that social media companies deliberately designed their platforms to be addictive. Social media companies lost the first such trial to the tune of US$6 million in damages in March. Plaintiffs referred to in court papers as S.J., a 16-year-old girl from Illinois, and K.D.B., an 18-year-old woman from Mississippi, have said they began using YouTube as early as age 3 or 4 and other platforms around age 9. They have alleged that autoplay, infinite scroll and other features drove them to compulsive use, and they developed depression, anxiety and eating disorders as a result. The trial, which begins with the jury selection process on Wednesday, is expected to run for several weeks. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, Instagram head Adam Mosseri and Snap CEO Evan Spiegel are expected to testify. The two plaintiffs initially sued TikTok and Alphabet's YouTube, in addition to Meta and Snap. Both reached settlements with TikTok and YouTube ahead of trial, and the Illinois plaintiff also settled with Meta. Wednesday's trial covers claims by both plaintiffs against Snap, and the Mississippi plaintiff's claims against Meta. Meta and Snap have asked Los Angeles Superior Court Judge Carolyn Kuhl, presiding over the proceedings, to split the cases into separate trials, arguing that trying them together would unfairly mix up the evidence for jurors. The judge has not yet ruled on that request. 'A YOUNG PERSON'S MENTAL HEALTH' A Meta spokesperson said the company disagrees with the claims made against it and has built protections into its platforms for a decade. Meta owns Instagram and Facebook. "A young person's mental health is shaped by many factors, as the evidence in this trial will show," the spokesperson said in a statement. "The plaintiff used TikTok far more than Instagram or Facebook, and her personal circumstances were a substantial factor in her struggles." A Snap spokesperson said its Snapchat platform is different from traditional social media because it does not open to a feed or a ranking of what other people post. The company has built safeguards into its platform, the spokesperson said. "We believe the evidence will support that we have put our community first, and that these allegations fundamentally misrepresent their experiences on Snapchat and how our platform was designed," the spokesperson said. Emily Jeffcott, an attorney representing the Mississippi plaintiff, said in a statement ahead of the trial that "we look forward to educating the jury about the dangers of features like endless feeds, autoplay and streaks and how Meta – and allegedly Snap as well – have implemented and emphasized these features." A TEST CASE Plaintiffs S.J. and K.D.B. sued in 2023. Both described staying awake for hours scrolling social media, losing focus in class and engaging in self-harm using methods shown in social media videos. They are seeking unspecified compensatory and punitive damages. Their cases are among more than 3,000 lawsuits brought by individuals and others that have been consolidated in Los Angeles Superior Court. Their lawsuits have been selected as bellwethers, or test cases, meaning the verdict could influence how the companies and plaintiffs resolve the remaining cases. Social media companies have denied that their platforms were designed to addict young people, and have said they have taken action to make the apps safe for young users. They also have argued that they are shielded from the claims by Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act, a 1996 federal law that generally protects online platforms from liability over user-generated content. The trial judge disagreed that Section 230 bars claims over how the sites are designed, and allowed the suits by the two plaintiffs to go to trial. In the case decided in March, a Los Angeles jury found that Meta and YouTube were negligent, siding with a young woman referred to in court papers as Kaley G.M. There have been multiple cases scheduled for trial since then, but the companies have settled the claims or, in some cases, the plaintiffs have chosen to drop them. SCHOOL DISTRICTS AND STATES SUE More than 3,800 lawsuits brought by states, school districts and individuals over similar claims are pending in federal court in California, court records showed. In August, Meta reached settlements worth up to US$18 billion to resolve claims made by nearly every US state and territory over the impact of its platforms on teen mental health. The company agreed as part of that deal to change how teens can access Instagram and Facebook. Members of Meta's senior legal team told reporters after that settlement that the company views the individual and school district cases as harder to prove at trial than cases brought by states because they require plaintiffs to directly link specific problems to its social media platforms. Meta is appealing the verdict in the case decided in March, arguing that Section 230 should have barred the claims by plaintiff Kaley G.M. A ruling in Meta's favor on the issue could derail thousands of lawsuits over youth mental health and shield it from billions of dollars in potential liability that the company has said poses a serious threat to its future, according to experts. bd.title: UNESCO-Listed Nandagang Wetland Launches Global Photo Contest on Migratory Birds and Wetland Conservation
bd.description: The 2026 contest, a key component of Global Wetland Week invites photographers worldwide to tell stories of wetlands and migratory birds along the East Asian–Australasian Flyway. Nandagang Wetland lies within the UNESCO-listed Yellow Sea–Bohai Gulf migratory bird sanctuary, a vital link in a flyway spanning about 22 countries. CANGZHOU, China, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cangzhou International Communication Center has launched Global Wetland Week, an international campaign that uses wetlands as common ground for dialogue and cultural exchange. A key component of the campaign is the 2026 Nandagang International Wetland Photo Contest, which invites photographers and video creators around the world to share wetland stories through images and bring wider public attention to wetland conservation. 2026 Nandagang Wetland Photo Contest | A Message from Our Judges Located in Cangzhou, Hebei Province, Nandagang Wetland is part of the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Migratory Bird Sanctuaries along the Coast of Yellow Sea-Bohai Gulf of China. In recent years, more than 300 hectares of wetland have been restored. Migratory bird numbers rose from about 20,000 in 2019 to more than 150,000 in 2025, while recorded bird species increased from 268 in 2021 to 274, according to the Cangzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau. Under the theme "Together for Wetlands," the contest welcomes photographs and videos about wetland landscapes, migratory birds, local communities and conservation. It is open to photographers, videographers, nature observers and young creators worldwide. Reflecting on the inaugural edition, Ma Chaode, Assistant Resident Representative at UNDP in China, said: "Wetlands, one of the three major ecosystems, are known as the 'Kidneys of the Earth.' They have functions like provision, support, regulation and culture, and are the foundation for the sustainable development of human society. The numerous wetland ecological images collected in the event vividly show the real - life beautiful scenery of the harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. It's not only a vivid microcosm of "Beautiful China", but also a typical case for promoting global ecological civilization." "For me, photography is a way to connect people with nature and inspire its conservation," said Mario Suárez Porras, president of AFONAS and a judge for this year's contest. "I'm excited to see creative works for this year's theme." The contest is organized by Cangzhou International Communication Center, hosted by Xinhuanet North America, with media support from Xinhuanet Hebei Channel. Email submissions are available as a backup at cangzhouNDGphotoweek@gmail.com. Awards and recognition: A US$1,500 Grand Prize, additional cash prizes, special awards and honorable mentions. Entries will be reviewed by a ten-member international jury. ae.title: Dubai Police raises security and digital safety awareness among Bangladeshi residents
ae.description: Dubai: Under the umbrella of the Ministry of Interior, the Positive Spirit Council at the Dubai Police, in cooperation with strategic partners, organised a series of security, traffic and community awareness lectures, alongside specialised cybersecurity lectures, for 427 residents from the Bangladeshi community at the Marco Polo Hotel in Deira. The lectures come within ongoing efforts to enhance community awareness and consolidate a culture of safety and security among the various communities residing in the emirate of Dubai. The awarness lectures addressed a number of security and traffic topics, including promoting positive behaviours, compliance with the laws and regulations in force in the country, and strengthening the culture of traffic safety, along with presenting the smart services provided by Dubai Police and the channels for communicating with the public, helping to facilitate access to police services for various segments of society. In conjunction with Cybersecurity Awareness Month, the lectures included awareness of the most prominent electronic fraud methods and cybercrimes, the risks of sharing personal and banking data, and ways to deal safely with suspicious links and messages, with emphasis on the importance of protecting electronic accounts, not disclosing passwords or verification codes, and reporting fraud attempts through official approved channels. The Positive Spirit Council also gave special attention to educating members of the Bangladeshi community on the preventive measures to be followed in the event of unstable weather conditions as winter approaches, with the aim of enhancing community readiness and raising awareness of how to deal safely with weather fluctuations and exceptional climatic conditions. The awareness highlighted the importance of following weather bulletins and warnings issued by the National Center of Meteorology and the relevant official authorities, avoiding unnecessary outings during severe weather, staying away from areas where rainwater collects, valley streams, and low-lying areas, and not risking crossing roads flooded with water. The lectures also covered the importance of adhering to speed limits and leaving safe distances between vehicles during rainfall, avoiding phone use while driving, staying away from lighting poles and exposed electrical connections, and not approaching trees or unstable structures during strong winds. The awareness also addressed the importance of securing belongings in open areas, following safety instructions in homes and workplaces, and contacting the relevant authorities in the event of emergencies, along with informing them of the emergency numbers: 999 for emergencies and 901 for inquiries and non-emergency cases. Ms. Fatima Ahmed Buhajeer, Chairperson of the Positive Spirit Council at Dubai Police, affirmed that the event reflects Dubai Police's keenness to enhance direct communication with various communities, and to deliver awareness, security, and preventive messages to all segments of society, in line with its strategic directions in enhancing safety, security, and quality of life. Buhajeer said: "Our community responsibility is not limited to spreading security, traffic, and cyber culture, but extends to anticipating potential risks and enhancing community readiness to deal with them, especially in light of the weather fluctuations that the country may witness during the coming period, because we believe that awareness is the first line of defence, and that human safety remains a top priority in all our community initiatives and programmes." She added: "At the Positive Spirit Council, we are keen to reach various communities in their gathering places, and to provide awareness in simplified ways that take into account their cultural and linguistic diversity, ensuring that preventive messages reach the largest possible segment, enhancing trust and positive communication between the police and the community, and embodying Dubai's position as a global model in security, coexistence and community cohesion." Buhajeer concluded by affirming the importance of concerted efforts among government entities, strategic partners, and community members, and the necessity of sourcing information from official sources and not circulating rumours, noting that adherence to preventive guidelines and responsible behaviour contribute to protecting lives and property and enhancing community safety and security.

ae.title: UNESCO-Listed Nandagang Wetland Launches Global Photo Contest on Migratory Birds and Wetland Conservation
ae.description: The 2026 contest, a key component of Global Wetland Week invites photographers worldwide to tell stories of wetlands and migratory birds along the East Asian–Australasian Flyway. Nandagang Wetland lies within the UNESCO-listed Yellow Sea–Bohai Gulf migratory bird sanctuary, a vital link in a flyway spanning about 22 countries. CANGZHOU, China, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cangzhou International Communication Center has launched Global Wetland Week, an international campaign that uses wetlands as common ground for dialogue and cultural exchange. A key component of the campaign is the 2026 Nandagang International Wetland Photo Contest, which invites photographers and video creators around the world to share wetland stories through images and bring wider public attention to wetland conservation. 2026 Nandagang Wetland Photo Contest | A Message from Our Judges Located in Cangzhou, Hebei Province, Nandagang Wetland is part of the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Migratory Bird Sanctuaries along the Coast of Yellow Sea-Bohai Gulf of China. In recent years, more than 300 hectares of wetland have been restored. Migratory bird numbers rose from about 20,000 in 2019 to more than 150,000 in 2025, while recorded bird species increased from 268 in 2021 to 274, according to the Cangzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau. Under the theme "Together for Wetlands," the contest welcomes photographs and videos about wetland landscapes, migratory birds, local communities and conservation. It is open to photographers, videographers, nature observers and young creators worldwide. Reflecting on the inaugural edition, Ma Chaode, Assistant Resident Representative at UNDP in China, said: "Wetlands, one of the three major ecosystems, are known as the 'Kidneys of the Earth.' They have functions like provision, support, regulation and culture, and are the foundation for the sustainable development of human society. The numerous wetland ecological images collected in the event vividly show the real - life beautiful scenery of the harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. It's not only a vivid microcosm of "Beautiful China", but also a typical case for promoting global ecological civilization." "For me, photography is a way to connect people with nature and inspire its conservation," said Mario Suárez Porras, president of AFONAS and a judge for this year's contest. "I'm excited to see creative works for this year's theme." The contest is organized by Cangzhou International Communication Center, hosted by Xinhuanet North America, with media support from Xinhuanet Hebei Channel. Call for Entries Theme: "Together for Wetlands" Who can enter: Photographers, videographers, nature observers and young creators worldwide Categories: Global Wetlands; Wetlands and Migratory Birds; People and Wetlands; Nandagang Wetland; Youth Imaging (under 28); Wetland Conservation Stories (video) Submission deadline: November 28, 2026 Entry fee: Free How to enter: Submit at globalsouthernnews.com/ndg2026. Email submissions are available as a backup at cangzhouNDGphotoweek@gmail.com. Awards and recognition: A US$1,500 Grand Prize, additional cash prizes, special awards and honorable mentions. Entries will be reviewed by a ten-member international jury. For complete eligibility requirements, submission instructions, technical specifications and copyright terms, visit globalsouthernnews.com/ndg2026

sa.title: بعد دعم إنفانتينو .. استقالة نائب رئيس الاتحاد الياباني
sa.description: استقال تاكيشي أوكادا، نائب رئيس الاتحاد الياباني لكرة القدم، من منصبه، معتبرًا أن «سلسلة المواقف» المتصلة بالجدل المحيط بكأس العالم لا تنسجم مع قناعاته الشخصية، بحسب بيان نشره الأربعاء. وقال أوكادا، أحد نواب رئيس الاتحاد الياباني الثلاثة، إنه يتنحى عن منصبه «بمحض إرادته بالكامل». وأضاف «طوال مسيرتي، كنت أؤمن بالقيمة الاجتماعية للرياضة انطلاقًا من قناعتي بأن الرياضة يجب أن تُمارس بنزاهة». وتابع «لكن فيما يتعلق بسلسلة المواقف المرتبطة بكأس العالم الأخيرة، أرى فجوة كبيرة بين تلك المواقف وبين معتقداتي الشخصية، وبوصفي رجل رياضة لا أستطيع قبولها». وجاءت استقالة أوكادا الذي أشرف على تدريب منتخب اليابان في كأس العالم عامي 1998 و2010، بعد أسبوع من إعلان الشيخ سلمان بن إبراهيم آل خليفة، رئيس الاتحاد الآسيوي، دعم القارة لترشح السويسري الإيطالي جياني إنفانتينو لولاية جديدة على رأس الاتحاد الدولي «فيفا». وكان الشيخ سلمان عبّر بوضوح عن هذا الدعم خلال اجتماع عقد في طوكيو. وجاء ذلك بعد أسابيع من انضمام الاتحاد الآسيوي إلى هيئات كروية في أوروبا وأمريكا الشمالية في إدانة إنفانتينو بسبب خطته لفتح الباب أمام مستثمرين من القطاع الخاص للمشاركة في ملكية أو استثمار مسابقات «فيفا» الكبرى، ومنها كأس العالم. وواجه إنفانتينو دعوات للاستقالة، كما فقد دعم بعض الاتحادات في مسعاه للفوز بولاية رابعة وأخيرة. ويترأس إنفانتينو الاتحاد الدولي منذ 2016، ويخوض الانتخابات مارس المقبل، بعدما قدم اعتذارًا عن مشروع الاستثمار الخاص الذي لم يُكتب له النجاح. وقبل شهرين، كان الاتحاد الآسيوي والشيخ سلمان أظهرا مؤشرات إلى احتمال معارضة إنفانتينو. وجاء في رسالة مشتركة مع الاتحاد الأوروبي للعبة «يويفا» واتحاد أمريكا الشمالية والوسطى والكاريبي «كونكاكاف» أن كرة القدم «لا تخص أي فرد». وأوضح أوكادا أن قراره «جاء بعد تفكير متأن ومتكرر». وأضاف «مع الأخذ في الاعتبار علاقتنا بالاتحاد الآسيوي وتأثير ذلك على كرة القدم اليابانية، فإنني أتفهم وجود أسباب عملية تدفع إلى مواءمة موقفنا مع موقف الاتحاد الآسيوي».

iq.title: غرق ودهس وصعق.. مصرع 3 أشخاص في بغداد وديالى
iq.description: شفق نيوز- ديالى/ بغداد لقي ثلاثة أشخاص مصرعهم، يوم الأربعاء، بحوادث غرق ودهس وصعق كهربائي في بغداد وديالى، وفق مصدران أمنيان وبيان رسمي. وقال مصدر أمني في ديالى لوكالة شفق نيوز، إن فرق البحث عثرت، اليوم، على جثة طالب في المرحلة الثانوية، من مواليد عام 2011، غرقاً في مشروع ماء الخالص الإروائي غرب مدينة بعقوبة، بعد فقدانه أمس، مبيناً أنه جرى نقل جثته إلى دائرة الطب العدلي. وأضاف المصدر أن قوة أمنية أوقفت اثنين من أصدقاء الطالب في مركز شرطة الأحداث، للتحقيق معهما وكشف ملابسات الحادث، ومعرفة ما إذا كان الغرق عرضياً أم ناجماً عن فعل متعمد. وفي بغداد، أفاد مصدر أمني للوكالة، بأن شاباً من مواليد عام 2005 لقي مصرعه إثر حادث دهس عند نزلة جسر الطابقين في منطقة الدورة، بعدما صدمته عجلة يقودها موظف في وزارة الكهرباء بسرعة عالية، وفقاً للمصدر. وأشار إلى نقل جثة الشاب إلى دائرة الطب العدلي، فيما أوقفت القوات الأمنية سائق العجلة وفق الإجراءات الأصولية. وفي حادث منفصل، نعت وزارة الكهرباء العراقية أحد منتسبيها، ويدعى (علي مجيد حمود الساعدي)، العامل في الشركة العامة لتوزيع كهرباء بغداد، فرع الصدر- قطاع بوب الشام، بعد وفاته متأثراً بإصابته بصعقة كهربائية أثناء تأدية واجبه الوظيفي، وفق بيان ورد لوكالة شفق نيوز.

iq.title: أشبال العراق يخسرون أمام مدغشقر ويواجهون غواتيمالا في مونديال تحت 15 عاماً
iq.description: شفق نيوز - بغداد خسر منتخب العراق للأشبال، اليوم الأربعاء، أمام نظيره منتخب مدغشقر بنتيجة (2-1)، ضمن منافسات المستوى (B) في بطولة كأس العالم ومهرجان FIFA لكرة القدم تحت 15 سنة، المقامة حالياً في أذربيجان. وبهذه الخسارة، يتجه المنتخب العراقي لمواجهة نظيره الغواتيمالي ضمن مرحلة المنافسة على المراكز الترتيبية من 49 إلى 64. وكان الأشبال قد تأهلوا إلى المستوى (B) بعد حلولهم في المركز الثاني بالمجموعة (S) برصيد 12 نقطة، خلف المنتخب المصري الذي تصدر المجموعة بالعلامة الكاملة (15 نقطة) إثر تحقيقه الفوز في مبارياته الخمس. وحقق المنتخب العراقي أربعة انتصارات متتالية على جزر كايمان، وترينيداد وتوباغو، وماكاو، وسانت كيتس ونيفيس، قبل أن يتلقى خسارته الأولى أمام مصر بنتيجة (1-4)، ليحجز مقعده في المستوى (B) الذي تتنافس منتخباته على المراكز من 33 إلى 64 في الترتيب العام. يُذكر أن البطولة تُقام بنظام 8 لاعبين لكل فريق على ملعب بأبعاد (68×47 متراً)، بواقع شوطين مدة كل منهما 20 دقيقة، وبمشاركة لاعبين من مواليد 2011 و2012، بهدف احتكاك الباعثين الصغار وتطوير مهاراتهم الكروية.
